name: Finova
subtitle: Private Budget & Spending
promotionalText: See income, spending, and budgets in a private local ledger. Unlock Finova Plus once for deeper insights, unlimited budgets, and CSV export.
description:
Understand the money you record without creating an account or connecting a bank. Finova is a local-first ledger for tracking income, expenses, and monthly category budgets.

YOUR MONTH AT A GLANCE

• Add, edit, search, filter, and delete transactions.
• See recorded income, spending, balance, and savings rate.
• Set repeating monthly category limits.
• Read on-track, near-limit, and over-limit budget states.
• Review deterministic six-month income and expense patterns.

YOUR DATA, YOUR ACTION

Finance data is stored locally in this app. Finova has no account, bank connection, ads, tracking, or behavioral product-usage analytics. JSON backup and CSV export happen only when you choose them through the iOS share sheet. Import validates a Finova backup and asks before replacing active data. Delete All removes active app data and Finova-owned temporary files from this installation. Existing device backups may restore earlier data.

IMPORTANT LIMITS

Finova reports only the entries you provide. Totals may be incomplete or wrong when information is missing or entered incorrectly. Finova is not financial, tax, legal, credit, or investment advice. It does not access accounts, block purchases, predict bills, detect fraud, execute transactions, or guarantee any outcome.
